facts.statement: harness is required and user-specified; there is no default
source root is the directory containing the skills/ directory
queries file and facts.json default under <source-root>/skills-workspace/<skill>/retrieval-tests/
empty fact inventory → stop; retrieval testing is not required
retrieval measures the force-loaded body; description triggering is trigger testing's track
consume harness exit codes and JSON only, never prose stdout
keep statements passing one test: directive, threshold, taxonomy, structure, routing, scope, assumption-correction
drop rationales, restatements, examples, transitions; frontmatter conventions are out of scope
cluster facts per task-shaped query; derive the query from the failure mode
manifest holds ids, sections, statements, entries, exclusions — never query text
rebuild the inventory fresh every campaign; the manifest is a baseline, never a cache
new fact → propose; changed → re-score verbatim; deleted → propose pruning
never name the fact's section or file, hint the answer, or quote rubric text
queries stand alone and stay verbatim across campaigns, {RUN_DIR} token included
a scenario passes only when every expect bullet is met
a fixtures list is required exactly when the query contains {RUN_DIR}
default to inline, self-contained queries
fixtures live under fixtures/ next to the queries file, copied fresh per run
two agents, identical except skill allow vs deny
agents pin no model config; campaign flags are the only selection path
the per-run prompt is the bare query, never naming the skill
the control workspace never contains the skill
bash is denied, so a skill's executable scripts value cannot be exercised
preflight: python3 >= 3.10 and evaluator harness check before any spend
two retrieval-test-prefixed workspaces; sync --full into the skill workspace only
snapshot queries, facts, and the synced skill into the campaign dir, recording commands
confirm planned spend before the first eval, every campaign including re-runs
score via retrieval-evidence: answer_text only, void_signals, worst non-void run
record only a completed full campaign, --scope dir, with all four counts
mini-campaign: failed entries only, second campaign dir, filtered queries, never recorded
fix failures by editing the doc — never behavioral rules or prohibitions
findability fixes are information architecture: headings, TOC, quick-reference rows
fix between campaigns, never mid-campaign
one more revision for a still-failing scenario, then surface to the user
ablation flag: re-check next campaign, retire only if the baseline keeps passing
one card per entry showing the full query text
fact ids are section-anchored and stable across campaigns
cost is a formula (entries × 2 arms × reps); fixtures line always present
account for every fact exactly once — covered or excluded with reason
only completed full campaigns are recorded; aborted/mini marked not recorded
classification (findability|clarity) is required exactly when result is fail
ablation_flag is true exactly when the control passes
missed_bullets are verbatim rubric strings, non-empty for fail and gap
the four counts must match; every results id accounted for exactly once
a missing skill-load signal is void, not fail
a control pass is a flag, not a verdict
never let the eval agent know it is being tested
artifacts live in the persistent campaign dir, never the temp workspaces
no pressure or obstacles in retrieval queries — plain realistic tasks

restates rules from earlier sections; no new facts
